result.rationale: The diff shows parseRefreshTokenResponse setting `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing, and callers (e.g. GoogleCalendarService saving `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, ...)` via prisma.credential.update, and Office365 spreading tokenResponse.data into credentials) persist that literal sentinel as a real refresh token. If the sync endpoint is later disabled/unset, that sentinel would be sent to the provider, breaking refresh. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff, though its real-world severity depends on configuration toggling.

judged_text: When the token response has no refresh_token, the code writes the literal sentinel string "refresh_token" into the parsed data, which callers then persist as the credential's real refresh_token. The sentinel is stored as data in the DB; if CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is later unset while APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED stays on (or vice versa), the next direct refresh sends the literal string "refresh_token" to the provider as a refresh token, permanently breaking that credential's refresh.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `parseRefreshTokenResponse` which, on a successful parse, forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" when the provider response lacks it (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`). Call sites then use the parsed data to update persisted credentials (e.g., Office365: spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` and then updates Prisma; Zoom: assigns `parsedToken = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` in the refresh flow; similar pattern elsewhere). This means a missing refresh_token can overwrite the stored real refresh token with the sentinel. If later `refreshOAuthTokens` switches back to using the direct provider refresh (e.g., `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` removed while `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` remains truthy), the code will send the literal "refresh_token" as the refresh token, breaking the credential.
